newsitem.title: GREECE: GREECE, EIB SIGN 5.6 BILLION DRACHMA FINANCING DEALS.
newsitem.headline: GREECE, EIB SIGN 5.6 BILLION DRACHMA FINANCING DEALS.

text.p: The European Investment Bank (EIB) and Greece signed two contracts for the financing of two projects budgeted at 5.6 billion drachmas, the national economy ministry said in a statement.
Greek Deputy National Economy Minister, Christos Pahtas, and the Vice-President of European Investment Bank (EIB), Panayiotis Yennimatas, signed the contracts on Monday.
The first project is budgeted at 3.5 billion drachmas and relates to the environmental and urban development of the city of Kalamata in the Peloponnese.
Financing from European Economic Area countries for the first project amounts to 3.0 billion drachmas, it said.

The second project relates to the procurement of equipment for the fire brigades and is budgeted at 2.1 billion drachmas of which 1.8 billion is provided by the financing mechanism of European Economic Area countries.
